leadStory: Liverpool confirmed on Monday that Cody Gakpo has withdrawn from the Netherlands squad with an ankle injury and will be assessed at the AXA; Dutch journalist Rik Elfrink reports he will be out for several weeks, likely missing Manchester City at Anfield on 11 October.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is an injury withdrawal from international duty, not a single Liverpool still. Antigravity should take no action.
